answers.how: The singles sidelines are about 299 pixels apart, giving 8.23/299 m per pixel. At the beginning, the player centers are approximately 218 pixels apart, corresponding to 6.0 m.
During the ball's flight across the net, it moves approximately 499 pixels between 0.733 s and 1.467 s. Using the court scale of 8.23/299 m per pixel gives an average speed of 18.7 m/s.
The right player's center moves approximately 106 pixels between the first and last frames. Multiplying by the court scale of 8.23/299 m per pixel gives a displacement of 2.9 m.
